newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wharf's Plaza Hollywood mostly rented.
newsitem.headline: Wharf's Plaza Hollywood mostly rented.

text.p: Wharf (Holdings) Ltd sees an annual rental revenue of HK$220 million for its newly completed joint venture retail development in Kowloon's Diamond Hill, Wharf's executive director Doreen Lee said on Tuesday.

"More than 98 percent of the shopping area has been rented out which is expected to generate an annual income of about HK$220 million," Lee told reporters after a ceremony to mark the opening of a Hang Seng Bank branch in the centre, Plaza Hollywood.
Lee said space in the four-storey, about 560,000 square foot Plaza Hollywood site was leased out at rents above the company's target of between HK$40 and HK$180 per square foot.
The Diamond Hill project is equally owned by Wharf, its controlling shareholder Wheelock and Co Ltd and Wheelock's subsidiary New Asia Realty and Trust Co Ltd.
The development also includes five residential towers containing 1.2 million square feet of floor space area adjacent to the retail centre.
Lee said the residential buildings were expected to be completed in the fourth quarter of the year, slightly behind the company's scheduled completion date in August.
"The project is developed on a virgin land and we met some unexpected technical problems," she said. Lee said the price or sales schedule for the residential towers had not been decided yet.
